outcome: Turn customer data questions into decisions in seconds
overview: Give marketing, ecommerce and insights teams direct access to governed customer data. Ask questions in plain English, analyse performance and receive traceable answers without waiting for dashboards, SQL development or analyst queues.

benefits.text: A business question about customer behaviour gets a governed, traceable answer in minutes instead of a data-team ticket that takes days
benefits.source: Syntasa — Customer Insights Agent marketing video and LinkedIn walkthrough (both show a question answered, with its query and takeaways, inside a single session)
benefits.limits: Depends on how well the underlying warehouse schema is modelled and labelled; an undocumented schema limits what any natural-language layer can correctly map a business term onto

benefits.text: No new copy of customer data is created to answer the question — the agent queries the existing governed warehouse in place
benefits.source: Syntasa — Customer Insights Agent product page and Google Cloud Blog coverage of the BigQuery integration, both describing a zero-copy access model
benefits.limits: The zero-copy claim is the vendor’s own architecture description; Redington has not independently verified data-egress behaviour in a live deployment

benefits.text: Every answer carries the SQL and data lineage that produced it, so a business user can check a number rather than take it on faith
benefits.source: Syntasa — Customer Insights Agent marketing video, showing a “SQL Inspector” and “Data Lineage” panel alongside a returned answer
benefits.limits: Traceability depends on lineage metadata already being maintained in the warehouse; an unmodelled or undocumented schema limits what the agent can explain about its own answer

residency: Runs inside the customer’s own cloud data-warehouse account. Syntasa states zero data egress and no vendor access to the underlying customer data; Redington has not independently verified this in a live deployment.

notFor.situation: An organisation with no cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks or Redshift) already holding its customer data
notFor.why: The agent queries data in place inside an existing warehouse; there is nothing for it to query if the customer data has not already been consolidated into one

notFor.situation: A question that needs a judgement call the agent cannot make, such as why a customer churned rather than what the churn rate is
notFor.why: Every demonstrated session answers a quantitative question against structured data; none shows the agent reasoning about causation or intent

scope:
Model: Redington solutions engineering, with Syntasa as the licensing and implementation-support vendor · Duration: Unestimated — no Redington-run engagement exists yet to measure a real timeline from
Support model: Vendor subscription support for the agent platform; Redington coordinates the vendor relationship and holds the pilot delivery.
1) Discovery — confirm the warehouse, its schema readiness and a first named question set
2) Pilot — the agent configured and run against the named question set with a named business owner
3) Decision — the pilot outcome reviewed against the readiness instrument before any wider rollout is scoped
deliverables: The agent returns a correct answer, with its SQL and lineage attached, for every question in the named pilot set
The named business owner confirms the pilot’s own stated success measure was met, or clearly was not
effort: Unestimated — no Redington-run engagement exists yet to measure a real timeline from
